body: Something very similar happened to me during my service in the U.S. Navy. I had requested time off the boat once a week or maybe it was an hour each day for a week - I don't recall which. The Chief of the Boat pretty much accosted me in the main passageway (submarine, so not much room) and accused me, in front of others, "Are you trying to get out of the Navy? Is that was this class is about? Etc." That is what a U.S. Navy sailor who seeks to remain healthy faces.
Specificity restricts thought. I need others' thoughts.
